model_annotation: The plot illustrates the sharpness composition of two different lines across training steps. The x-axis is labeled "Training Steps", has a linear scale, and ranges from 0 to 6400 with tick labels at intervals of 1600. The y-axis is labeled "Sharpness composition", has a logarithmic scale, and ranges from 10^-3 to 10^0 with tick labels at intervals of one order of magnitude. The blue line starts at approximately 0.95, remains relatively steady, and ends at around 0.9, with minimal variation across the x-axis. The orange line begins at 1, sharply decreases to around 0.01 at 400 training steps, then fluctuates between 0.01 and 0.1, peaking at around 0.1 at 3200 training steps before decreasing to approximately 0.03 at 6400 training steps.
